events.title: Pius IX defines the Immaculate Conception
events.shortBlurb: In the bull Ineffabilis Deus, Pope Pius IX solemnly defined that the Blessed Virgin Mary was preserved free from original sin from the first moment of her conception…
body: On 8 December 1854, in the Apostolic Constitution Ineffabilis Deus, Pope Pius IX defined as a dogma of faith that the Blessed Virgin Mary, in the first instant of her conception, was by a singular grace of God and in view of the merits of Christ preserved free from all stain of original sin.
Four years later the apparitions at Lourdes, in which the Lady named herself “the Immaculate Conception,” were widely received as a confirmation of the definition.
